RAJYA SABHA
Friday, 5th July, 2019/14 Ashadha, 1941 (Saka)
The House met at twenty-five minutes past one of the clock,
MR. CHAIRMAN  in the Chair.
THE UNION BUDGET, 2019-20
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE; AND THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE 
AFFAIRS (SHRIMATI NIRMALA SITHARAMAN): Sir, I lay on the Table, a 
statement (in English and Hindi) of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the 
Government for the year 2019-20. [Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 116/17/19]
————
FISCAL POLICY STATEMENTS, 2019-20
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE; AND THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE 
AFFAIRS (SHRIMATI NIRMALA SITHARAMAN) : Sir, I lay on the Table, under 
sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management 
Act, 2003, a copy each (in English and Hindi) of the following papers :—
(i) Medium-term Fiscal Policy-cum-Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement;
(ii) Macro-Economic Framework Statement.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 117/17/19]
MR. CHAIRMAN: The House stands adjourned till eleven of the clock on 
Monday, the 8th July, 2019.
The House then adjourned at twenty-six minutes 
past one of the clock till eleven of the clock  
on Monday, the 8th July, 2019.
